title: Self-designed doctorate in parapsychology at UC Berkeley

tellings.quote: And so that's how I ended up seven years later earning a doctoral degree in parasychology.

plain: In the 1970s, a student named Jeffrey Mishlove designed his own doctoral program at the University of California, Berkeley, and seven years later earned a doctorate in parapsychology, the study of psychic abilities. Mishlove tells Michels this about himself, and it means a major university once granted a degree in the field.
